mapper.insert: INSERT INTO piggy_banks (wallet_id, name, icon, target_amount) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{targetAmount})
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET status = 'CANCEL', canceled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, wallet_id, name, icon, target_amount, balance, bonus_type, bonus_value, status, is_favorite, first_deposited_at, target_reached_at, achieved_at, bonus_paid_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM piggy_banks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET bonus_type = #{piggyBankBonusType}, bonus_value = #{bonusValue}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET bonus_paid_at = #{bonusPaidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET balance = #{balance}, status = #{status}, first_deposited_at = #{firstDepositedAt}, target_reached_at = #{targetReachedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT pb.id AS piggyBankId, w.child_id AS childId, pb.balance AS balance FROM piggy_banks pb JOIN wallets w ON pb.wallet_id = w.id WHERE pb.status = 'PENDING_ACHIEVE' AND pb.first_deposited_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pb.first_deposited_at) <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET status = 'ACHIEVE', achieved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET is_favorite = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND is_favorite = TRUE
UPDATE piggy_banks SET is_favorite = #{favorite}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET balance = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT w.child_id FROM piggy_banks pb JOIN wallets w ON pb.wallet_id = w.id WHERE pb.id = #{piggyBankId}

SELECT pb.id AS piggyBankId, fr.parent_id AS parentId, pb.name AS name FROM piggy_banks pb JOIN wallets w ON pb.wallet_id = w.id JOIN family_relations fr ON fr.child_id = w.child_id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE pb.status = 'ACHIEVE' AND pb.bonus_type <> 'NONE' AND pb.bonus_paid_at IS NULL AND pb.achieved_at IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), pb.achieved_at) IN (0, 7, 14, 21)
